name: litco-agent-connector
description: Connect Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP agents to LitKit, LitLex and LitSpace with your own Litco connection token.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/litco-mcp.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x dist/litco-mcp.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && git diff --exit-code dist
